The skin texture on the hand appears overly smooth and waxy, lacking fine pore detail. The transition between the wrist and the sleeve/background is slightly soft, suggesting minor generation blur or smoothing.
The vertical bars show slight inconsistency in thickness and parallelism, particularly where they intersect with the subject's body, suggesting minor warping or depth mapping errors.
